name: Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 from Anheuser-Busch InBev condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss unaudited, six months ended 30 June 2026, unit USD million stored in absolute dollars. Revenue 31927 less printed cost of sales 13702 equals the printed gross profit 18225. Operating Expenses 9534 is printed distribution 3419 plus sales and marketing 4101 plus administrative 2397 (total SG&A 9917) less other operating income 369 and less the 14 exceptional income above EBIT, so gross profit less operating expenses equals the printed profit from operations 8691. Net Finance Costs 74 is the printed net finance expense (finance expense 2462 less finance income 2388). EBIT less Net Finance Costs is 8617 and the printed profit before tax is 8765, the 148 difference being the printed share of results of associates, which sits below EBIT. 8765 less income tax 1704 equals the printed profit of the period 7061; profit attributable to equity holders of AB InBev was 6314 and to non-controlling interests 747. Basic earnings per share 3.20 dollars. Source https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1668717/000119312526326320/R2.htm and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1668717/000119312526326285/d175040dex991.htm || Yahoo Finance
